title: autoUSD
tagline: Cross-chain USDC yield optimizer with automated rebalancing across L2 networks.
description:
autoUSD is a smart investment manager for your USDC that works across multiple blockchains automatically. 

Currently, earning yield on USDC requires researching rates, bridging funds manually, and dealing with complex wallets and gas fees. autoUSD solves this by doing everything automatically: you deposit USDC once using just your email (no crypto wallet needed), the system spreads your money across Base and Katana for the best yields. Can be extended to any L2.

The key innovation is complete blockchain abstraction - users interact via email only while the system handles all complexity, making DeFi as easy as traditional savings accounts.
how_its_made:
Backend: Smart contracts written in Solidity. Deployed across Base, and Katana L2s. Uses Circle's CCTP for secure USDC bridging. Uses Hyperlane V3 for cross-chain messaging. Features automated rebalancing when yield differences exceed 5%.

Frontend: Built with Next.js 14. Consumer-friendly interface. Circle Developer Controlled Wallets eliminate seed phrases. Email-only authentication required. Fern integration enables direct fiat purchases. Real-time dashboard shows yields and allocations.
